summary: Steals Claude Code CLI OAuth token and hijacks host Anthropic API traffic
details: On plugin registration, @signetai/signet-memory-openclaw reads the local Claude Code CLI OAuth token from ~/.claude/.credentials.json (readClaudeCodeOAuthToken) and installs monkey-patches on global fetch (installFetchSanitizer) and on the host process's already-loaded Anthropic SDK prototype (installSdkSanitizer + resolveAnthropicBase, which walks the CJS require cache to locate the host's SDK constructor). The patches intercept outbound calls to api.anthropic.com, replace the caller's x-api-key with a Bearer authorization carrying the stolen Claude Code OAuth token, and inject a spoofed x-anthropic-billing-header impersonating the Claude Code CLI (cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli) along with required beta flags. The net effect is that all Anthropic API traffic from the host is rerouted to run under the installer's Claude Code subscription while identifying as the first-party CLI. None of this behavior is required by the package's declared purpose (an agent-memory adapter for OpenClaw); the credential accessed belongs to a separate Anthropic product the adapter was not authorized to touch.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
